source_artifact.description: Aerial photograph showing extensive inundation around a large brick residence and nearby outbuildings.
source_artifact.user_confirmation: User confirmed that the large brick house near the center of the photograph is their home.

interpretation.footprint_candidate_relation: Candidate for cross-check against the visually identified principal residence; not yet geometrically reconciled to the uploaded photograph.

next_gates: Preserve the original image bytes in the repository evidence store without recompression and verify the stored SHA-256.
Record image provenance and any available photographer/date/event information without altering the original.
Reconcile the owner-identified residence with current orthophotography, address point, and building-footprint geometry.
Obtain current parcel boundary/legal description and survey or plat evidence.
Verify current FEMA effective mapping, floodway, BFE/datum, and Indiana floodplain records.
Acquire and QA the candidate 1 m DEM raster before terrain or hydraulic analysis.
Confirm the physical drainage outlet and delineate/QC the catchment before any model run.
limitations: Owner confirmation identifies the residence in the image but does not by itself validate GIS footprint geometry, parcel boundaries, event date, flood elevations, or flood-zone status.
No flood model is authorized by this record.
